judgment.observations: The reconstruction preserves the main composition: left bunk beds, central wooden wardrobe, right fireplace, timber walls, plank floor and cropped foreground bunk. Framing differs: the left bunks appear taller and more frontal, with shifted posts and ladder positions; the wardrobe is narrower and the fireplace opening is wider and more rectangular. The reference fireplace has a curved stone surround, irregular soot-darkened masonry and hearth clutter; the reconstruction simplifies these substantially. Bedding is flatter and less detailed, and small wall fixtures and ceiling details are missing or indistinct. Bed feet, wardrobe and hearth visibly meet the floor, though contact shadows differ. The floor is more uniformly brown, wall plaster cleaner, and wood and stone less weathered. Lighting is flatter and the render visibly grainy. Overall, the room and major object arrangement match well, but proportions, surface detail and illumination prevent a very close match.
judgment.uncertain_3d_hypotheses: The left bunk arrangement may extend differently into the room, and the wardrobe may sit closer to the bunks, but perspective and occlusion limit certainty. The fireplace surround appears shallower and more blocklike; this is an image-based impression, not verified depth. Hidden geometry and structural support cannot be assessed.
